hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f || exit 0; case "$f" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; RUFF=$(command -v ruff || echo "$HOME/.local/bin/ruff"); [ -x "$RUFF" ] || exit 0; "$RUFF" check -q --fix "$f"; "$RUFF" format -q "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f || exit 0; case "$f" in */t700/*.py|*/tests/*.py) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; out=$(distrobox enter t700-dev -- bash -c 'cd "$1" && python3 -m pytest tests -q -x --no-header' _ "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$HOME/Downloads/t700}" 2>&1) && exit 0; printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -25 >&2; exit 2; }
